title: Rethinking Agentic Model Orchestration for Time Series Forecasting
title_zh: 重新思考时间序列预测中的智能体模型编排

paragraphs.en: Foundation Models for Temporal Systems (FMTS)
paragraphs.zh: 时序系统基础模型 (FMTS)

paragraphs.en: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) perform unevenly across forecasting tasks. Recent work uses agentic model orchestration (AMO) to select or combine TSFMs, often outperforming individual forecasters. Yet these gains may reflect stronger or more complementary candidates rather than better orchestration. To disentangle these effects, we introduce FairAMO, a controlled evaluation protocol with frozen candidate forecasts. Experiments on GIFT-Eval show that AMO improves accuracy, but its gains are bounded by the candidate TSFMs. The best orchestrators reduce MASE by less than 6% relative to the best single TSFM across all tasks. These gains depend on complementarity (different candidates excel on different tasks) rather than the number of candidates. Adding members yields diminishing returns, and a redundant member can erase these gains. The value of historical evidence also saturates quickly. A few recent windows capture all gains, and further history adds none. These findings separate system-level forecasting gains from the contribution of orchestration itself.
paragraphs.zh: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在不同预测任务上的表现并不均衡。 近期研究采用智能体化模型编排（AMO）来选择或组合 TSFM，其效果往往优于单一预测器。 然而这些收益可能源于更强或更具互补性的候选模型，而非更好的编排。 为了厘清这些效应，我们提出 FairAMO，一种基于冻结候选预测结果的可控评估协议。 在 GIFT-Eval 上的实验表明，AMO 能够提升准确性，但其收益受限于候选 TSFM。 在所有任务中，最佳编排器相对于最佳单一 TSFM 仅将 MASE 降低不到 6%。 这些收益取决于互补性（不同候选模型在不同任务上各有所长），而非候选模型的数量。 增加成员的收益递减，而一个冗余成员可能会抵消这些收益。 历史证据的价值同样会迅速饱和。 少量近期窗口即可捕获全部收益，更多历史数据不再带来任何提升。 这些发现将系统层面的预测收益与编排本身的贡献区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Time series forecasting (TSF) supports critical decisions across a wide range of domains ( Jin et al., 2026 ; Guan et al., 2023 ; Guan et al., 2025 ; Guan et al., 2026a ) . Recent advances have expanded the forecasting paradigm from task-specific statistical and deep learning models to pretrained time series foundation models (TSFMs) that exhibit strong zero-shot generalization ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Guan et al., 2026b ) . This development has also motivated comprehensive benchmarks such as GIFT-Eval ( Aksu et al., 2024 ) , which covers more than 144,000 time series and 7 domains. Results on such diverse benchmarks show that no single TSFM consistently performs best across all datasets and forecasting settings. TimesFM ( Das et al., 2024 ) excels in long-horizon forecasting with extended contexts. Moirai ( Woo et al., 2024 ) robustly handles multivariate inputs with covariates. Chronos ( Ansari et al., 2024 ) captures distinct seasonality in short univariate series. Treating any single model as universally best sacrifices higher accuracy for a significant fraction of real-world inputs. This performance heterogeneity makes model orchestration a promising strategy for practical deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 时间序列预测（TSF）为众多领域的关键决策提供支持（Jin et al., 2026；Guan et al., 2023；Guan et al., 2025；Guan et al., 2026a）。 近期的进展将预测范式从任务特定的统计模型和深度学习模型扩展到了预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM），这类模型展现出强大的零样本泛化能力（Shi et al., 2025；Zhou et al., 2026；Guan et al., 2026b）。 这一发展也催生了 GIFT-Eval（Aksu et al., 2024）等综合性基准，其涵盖超过 144,000 条时间序列和 7 个领域。 在这类多样化基准上的结果表明，没有任何单一 TSFM 能在所有数据集和预测设置中始终保持最佳表现。 TimesFM（Das et al., 2024）在扩展上下文的长时程预测中表现出色。 Moirai（Woo et al., 2024）能够稳健地处理带协变量的多变量输入。 Chronos（Ansari et al., 2024）能捕捉短单变量序列中独特的季节性。 将任何单一模型视为普遍最优，会使相当大一部分真实世界输入牺牲更高的准确率。 这种性能异质性使得模型编排成为实际部署中一种有前景的策略。

paragraphs.en: Recent studies have explored agentic model orchestration (AMO) for selecting or combining candidate TSFMs. Their reported improvements over individual forecasters are striking ( Ning et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2025 ) . Notably, AMO systems currently occupy all of the top 10 positions on the GIFT-Eval leaderboard. Yet, leaderboard dominance alone does not establish that these gains originate from the orchestration mechanism, since the systems are evaluated with different candidate pools. This lack of control introduces two fundamental confounding factors. (1) Candidate strength , which determines the performance level available to the system before orchestration. As illustrated in Figure 1 (A), the same orchestrator can achieve substantially different results simply because it operates on stronger candidate forecasters. (2) Candidate complementarity , which determines the potential headroom available for orchestration. As illustrated in Figure 1 (B), a complementary pool whose members excel on different tasks leaves far more room for orchestration to improve over its best member than a redundant pool whose members succeed and fail in similar settings. Consequently, observed system performance jointly reflects candidate strength, candidate complementarity, and orchestration ability (Figure 1 (C)). Without controlling the first two factors, existing evaluations cannot isolate the contribution of the orchestrator itself.
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究已探索了智能体化模型编排（AMO），用于选择或组合候选的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）。 它们所报告的相对单个预测器的改进十分显著（Ning et al., 2026；Cao et al., 2025）。 值得注意的是，AMO 系统目前占据了 GIFT-Eval 排行榜前十的所有位置。 然而，仅凭在排行榜上的主导地位并不能证明这些收益源自编排机制，因为这些系统是在不同的候选池下进行评估的。 这种缺乏控制的情况引入了两个根本性的混淆因素。 （1）候选强度，即在编排之前决定系统可达到的性能水平的因素。 如图 1（A）所示，同一个编排器仅仅因为在更强的候选预测器上运行，就可能取得截然不同的结果。 （2）候选互补性，即决定编排可获得的潜在提升空间的因素。 如图 1（B）所示，与成员在相似情境下成败一致的冗余候选池相比，成员在不同任务上各有所长的互补性候选池为编排超越其最佳成员留下了远为充足的空间。 因此，观察到的系统性能共同反映了候选强度、候选互补性和编排能力（图 1（C））。 若不控制前两个因素，现有的评估就无法分离出编排器本身的贡献。

paragraphs.en: To disentangle these confounding factors, we introduce FairAMO, a controlled evaluation protocol built on a Frozen Forecast Bank. Within each comparison, all orchestrators operate on the same candidate forecasts and receive the same explicitly specified historical evidence. Each orchestrator must commit to either a model selection or a set of combination weights before the test labels are revealed, and all resulting forecasts are evaluated using the official GIFT-Eval protocol. By independently varying candidate pool composition, pool size, and evidence budget, our framework separates the contribution of the orchestrator from the properties of the candidate pool. Our contributions are threefold. (1) We provide a systematic taxonomy and reproducibility analysis of existing AMO systems. (2) We introduce FairAMO, a controlled protocol for comparing orchestration methods under identical candidate forecasts, evidence, and evaluation metrics for TSF. (3) Results show that orchestration gains are strongly conditioned by the candidate pool, while greater orchestration complexity and additional historical evidence do not consistently improve forecasting performance.
paragraphs.zh: 为了剥离这些混杂因素，我们提出了 FairAMO，这是一个基于冻结预测库（Frozen Forecast Bank）构建的受控评估协议。 在每次比较中，所有编排器都在相同的候选预测上运行，并接收相同的明确指定的历史证据。 每个编排器必须在测试标签揭示之前承诺一个模型选择或一组组合权重，所有产生的预测均使用官方 GIFT-Eval 协议进行评估。 通过独立地改变候选池的构成、池的规模和证据预算，我们的框架将编排器的贡献与候选池的特性分离开来。 我们的贡献有三点。 (1) 我们提供了现有 AMO 系统的系统性分类法与可复现性分析。 (2) 我们提出了 FairAMO，这是一个受控协议，用于在相同的候选预测、证据和时间序列预测（TSF）评估指标下比较编排方法。 (3) 结果表明，编排带来的收益强烈依赖于候选池，而更高的编排复杂度和更多的历史证据并不能持续提升预测性能。

paragraphs.en: Taxonomy. We distinguish three adaptive mechanisms according to how orchestration decisions are formed. (1) LLM-mediated orchestration uses an LLM to interpret forecasting evidence and guide model use, as in MoiraiAgent ( Yan et al., 2026 ) , TSOrchestra’s agent ( Cao et al., 2025 ) , and TimeCopilot’s agent framework ( Garza and Rosillo, 2025 ) . (2) Feature-conditioned orchestration learns a mapping from time series descriptors to orchestration decisions, as in TimeRouter ( Ning et al., 2026 ) , Toto-2.0 FnF ( Datadog, 2026 ) , and FFORMA ( Montero-Manso et al., 2020 ) . (3) Historical-error-driven orchestration determines decisions directly from past forecasting errors, as in RAES-Conductance-V ( AriGoldbach, 2026 ) and TSOrchestra SLSQP ( Cao et al., 2025 ) . The distinction concerns the decision mechanism, not merely whether training uses a loss function; multiple mechanisms may coexist within one system.

paragraphs.en: Reproducibility. We examine whether public artifacts support reconstructing an orchestrator under a changed candidate pool and a specified historical evidence budget. In the releases inspected in September 2026, MoiraiAgent, TimeRouter, and Toto FnF provide inference artifacts, but we did not locate complete training code for their orchestration components; RAES-Conductance-V and TSOrchestra SLSQP expose code for deriving and applying decisions. Thus, we reproduce AMO methods by reusing or adapting available repository components.

paragraphs.en: We treat every orchestrator as an ensemble function of candidate TSFMs. The framework has three stages, illustrated in Figure 2 . (1) Frozen Forecast Bank. All M M candidate TSFMs are run once on GIFT-Eval and are never retrained or fine-tuned afterwards. Their outputs are cached in a forecast bank indexed by (dataset, term, series, window, candidate, quantile) , where dataset and term (short, medium, or long horizon) identify a GIFT-Eval task and window a rolling forecast origin. Each entry stores the input history and the candidate’s quantile forecasts. The bank has three regions: training backtests and optional validation backtests, both with ground truth attached, and test forecasts, whose ground truth is withheld. Every orchestrator draws its K ≤ M K\leq M members from this same bank. (2) Orchestrator Fitting. Before any test label is revealed, the orchestrator receives the permitted evidence: the N N most recent training backtests, plus the validation backtests if available. Using only this evidence, it produces an orchestration strategy, either a model selection or a set of combination weights, which is then committed and frozen for the test period. No rerun, reweighting, or inspection of test scores is permitted after commitment. (3) Test Evaluation. The frozen strategy is applied to the cached test forecasts to produce the final prediction. Test labels are revealed only at this stage, and the official GIFT-Eval scorer then returns MASE and CRPS.

paragraphs.en: Existing orchestrators remain far from the ceiling that the candidate pool itself provides, leaving substantial room for improvement. Figure 2 (D) summarizes the 11 deployable methods in the same 5-candidate setting. Every method that gains more than 0.01 relies on backtest evidence.

paragraphs.en: Orchestration methods are highly sensitive to composition, no less so than to pool size. Figure 5 shows that the same Argmin Router spans 0.670–0.690 MASE over the ten size-3 subsets, a spread of 0.020 that matches in magnitude the 0.027 gained by growing the pool from two to five members, and the spread in realization is wider still, from 9.8% to 32.3%, a factor of three. This sensitivity comes from complementarity rather than strength: the best single TSFM of every subset falls between 0.697 and 0.703, a difference of approximately 0.006, whereas subsets containing TiRex2 realize 28.5% of their headroom on average against 13.4% for subsets without it.
paragraphs.zh: 编排方法对组合构成高度敏感，其敏感程度不亚于对池规模。 图5显示，同一个Argmin Router在十个规模为3的子集上MASE介于0.670–0.690之间，差距为0.020，其量级相当于将池从两个成员扩展到五个成员所获得的0.027提升；而实际实现中的差距更大，从9.8%到32.3%，相差三倍。 这种敏感性来自互补性而非强弱：每个子集中最佳的单个TSFM介于0.697和0.703之间，差异约为0.006，而包含TiRex2的子集平均实现其提升空间的28.5%，相比之下不包含TiRex2的子集仅为13.4%。

paragraphs.en: Introducing a weak candidate does not necessarily hurt; what matters is whether it contributes a new error profile. Toto2-313m is the weakest single model at 0.703, yet adding it to the six size-2 subsets that exclude it improves five of them, by up to 0.013 MASE. Conversely, a large headroom does not guarantee a realizable gain: Chronos2+Toto2-313m has a headroom of 0.048, close to the median, but realizes only 3.1%, because its members fail on the same configs and the evidence cannot separate them. Pools should therefore be grown by difference in error profile rather than by single-model ranking, and reported orchestration gains must be accompanied by the pool composition, since the realization of one and the same orchestrator can differ by a factor of three.
paragraphs.zh: 引入一个较弱的候选模型并不一定有害；关键在于它是否带来了新的错误模式。 Toto2-313m 是最弱的单模型，MASE 为 0.703，但将它加入排除它的六个规模为 2 的子集中，其中五个子集得到提升，最高提升 0.013 MASE。 反过来，较大的提升空间并不保证能实现实际增益：Chronos2+Toto2-313m 的提升空间为 0.048，接近中位数，但仅实现了 3.1%，因为其成员模型在相同的配置上失败，证据无法将它们区分开。 因此，模型池应按错误模式的差异而非单模型排名来扩展，且报告的编排增益必须附带模型池的组成情况，因为同一个编排器的实现效果可能相差三倍。

paragraphs.en: Under FairAMO, the central insight is that AMO improves accuracy, but its gains are bounded by the candidate pool, that these gains depend on complementarity rather than pool size, and that the value of historical evidence saturates quickly. However, the strongest methods are simple selection and weighting rules, leaving the contribution of LLM-mediated orchestration unclear. A single decision per config also limits realization of the available window-level headroom. Future work may therefore explore finer-grained commitments, agentic methods that use context beyond backtests, and candidate pools built around complementary error profiles rather than model rank.
paragraphs.zh: 在 FairAMO 下，核心洞察是：AMO 能提升准确率，但其收益受限于候选池；这些收益取决于互补性而非候选池规模；且历史证据的价值很快趋于饱和。 然而，表现最强的方法是简单的选择与加权规则，使得基于 LLM 的编排的贡献尚不明确。 每个配置仅做一次决策也限制了可用的窗口级提升空间的实现。 因此，未来工作可以探索更细粒度的承诺机制、利用回测之外上下文的智能体方法，以及围绕互补误差特征而非模型排名构建的候选池。

paragraphs.en: Every number reported in this paper is produced by the official GIFT-Eval scorer on the official test split, so the scores are directly comparable with the public leaderboard. This section defines the two official metrics first and then the quantities we derive from them.
paragraphs.zh: 本文报告的每一个数字均由官方 GIFT-Eval 评分器在官方测试集划分上产出，因此这些分数可直接与公开排行榜进行比较。 本节先定义两个官方指标，然后定义我们从这些指标中推导出的量。

sents.en: This section defines the two official metrics first and then the quantities we derive from them.
sents.zh: 本节先定义两个官方指标，然后定义我们从这些指标中推导出的量。

paragraphs.en: Official GIFT-Eval metrics. MASE is the mean absolute error of the point forecast divided by the in-sample mean absolute error of a seasonal naive forecast on the same series. The division makes errors comparable across series of very different scale, and a value below one means the forecast beats the seasonal naive baseline. CRPS is the continuous ranked probability score of the predicted quantiles, which rewards a well calibrated predictive distribution rather than a single point. The scorer returns both, and GIFT-Eval aggregates each of them over its tasks. Lower is better for both. We report MASE in every table and figure.
paragraphs.zh: 官方 GIFT-Eval 指标。 MASE 是点预测的平均绝对误差除以季节性朴素预测在同一序列上的样本内平均绝对误差。 这种除法使得误差在尺度差异极大的序列之间具有可比性，数值低于 1 表示预测优于季节性朴素基线。 CRPS 是预测分位数的连续排序概率得分，它奖励校准良好的预测分布，而非单个点。 评分器同时返回这两者，GIFT-Eval 则在其任务上对每个指标进行聚合。 两者的数值都是越低越好。 我们在所有表格和图中报告 MASE。

paragraphs.en: Units of evaluation. A config is one GIFT-Eval evaluation setting, that is a dataset paired with a forecast term, either short, medium or long. A window is one rolling forecast origin inside a config. Our protocol lets an orchestrator commit one decision per config, and that decision is then held fixed across the windows of the config. This distinguishes fixed per-config decisions from the window-level oracle defined next.
paragraphs.zh: 评估单元。 一个 config 即一个 GIFT-Eval 评估设置，也就是一个数据集与一个预测期（short、medium 或 long）的配对。 一个窗口即一个 config 内的一个滚动预测起点。 我们的协议允许编排智能体（orchestrator）针对每个 config 提交一次决策，且该决策在该 config 的所有窗口中保持固定。 这将每个 config 固定的决策与下一节定义的窗口级 oracle 区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Baseline and ceiling. The best single TSFM of a candidate pool is the member with the lowest MASE over the whole test split, and every gain we report is measured against it. It is deliberately a demanding reference: identifying it requires the test labels, so it is an optimistic stand-in for what a practitioner could actually deploy. Dev-Selected Best is its deployable counterpart, nominating one member from the permitted evidence alone. On the main pool it reaches 0.702 against 0.697, and that gap of 0.005 is the cost of having to choose in advance. The window-level oracle instead picks, for every window, the candidate with the lowest loss on that window, reading the test labels to do so. It is not deployable and is reported only as a lower bound on what member diversity could in principle deliver.
paragraphs.zh: 基线与上限。 候选池中最优的单一 TSFM 是在整个测试集划分上 MASE 最低的成员，我们报告的所有增益都是以它为基准度量的。 这是有意设置的一个高标准参照：确定它需要用到测试标签，因此对于从业者实际可部署的模型而言，它是一个乐观的替身。 Dev-Selected Best 是它可部署的对应版本，仅依据被允许的证据从候选中提名一个成员。 在主候选池上，它达到 0.702，对比 0.697，这一 0.005 的差距就是必须提前做出选择的代价。 窗口级神谕（oracle）则针对每个窗口，挑选在该窗口上损失最低的候选，为此它会读取测试标签。 它不可部署，仅作为成员多样性在原则上所能带来收益的下界而被报告。
